reviews.t: Excellent for gel nail application also
reviews.x: I used these to create a set of gel nails. I followed a tutorial on YouTube by JapanNailsandMore. I don't know her real name, but she's an experienced nail technician and cosmetologist who does great tutorial videos on YouTube. These forms are great for gel nail application, using clear builder gel (either non-soak off or soak-off) by IBD, and a UV light. You brush a small amount of the gel into the form and cure it on its own under the UV lamp for about 30 seconds, and then take it out. Then yo

I have never successfully communicated the shape I want at a nail salon. Today I finally achieved the look I've been going for, and I didn't have to leave my house. A few things to note: 1. I am not a professional but I have access to professionals and the supplies. 2. Any acrylic powder/liquid/primer works. 3. Make sure to use a good primer. 4. Watch the instructional video or YouTube. You do need to know how to work with acrylic and what to expect. 5. I have a steady hand and a lot of patience

I was VERY surprised by how easy these were to use and the shine!! No need to add a top coat, no bumps or unevenness. As a nail tech I would definitely recommend and use this on clients. Takes no time at all and you can get very creative with nail art. Plus, very easy to do yourself. Look up Nail forms on YouTube for excellent ideas and instructions! Be careful making sure you put enough acrylic on the sides otherwise your nails WILL break because there wasn't enough support!

I've done gel but this was my very first time ever using acrylics (used white acrylic so wouldn't have to paint them) and these forms made it soooo easy that I did my whole hand in a quarter of the time it takes be to use paper forms and hard gel build up! I hardly had to file them and most of the filing I did do was just because I made them to long and I'm on the computer all day and very long nails make it hard to type. They came out shiny and smooth didn't even need a top coat or polish) I ju

I'm still learning how to use these, but they should work well. However my beef is with the price. I didn't do research before purchasing so it's my fault that I paid too much. You can get the exact same brand name nail forms from Sally's at half the price.

The box says it all..Acrylics made simple.  I came across the acrylic application technique for nails by accident on youtube. reviews.t: Works amazing....but watch you tubes on it before using!
reviews.x: I really liked the fact that these allow for time consuming artwork that you can finish as you can, and then put on when complete!  It's a different format and takes some getting use to if you've done acrylics the good old fashioned way as I have for over ten years, but definitely has some benefits.

reviews.t: Such a disappointment and I won't be buying from STAR NAIL-ASP ever ...
reviews.x: The package I received was definitely NOT New. The acrylic powder, liquid and brush were all missing. The box was banged up,  and the bar code was drawn through with a permanent marker. Such a disappointment and I won't be buying from STAR NAIL-ASP ever again.

This is the one of the best products for those that do their own nails at home and are not very good with applying acrylic freestyle.  Just mix your acrylic onto the brush and pat it into the nail form, once that is done, turn the form over and press it onto your own nail and hold.  Scrap any access of from sides, wait approx. 3 mins. until acrylic hardens, then pull the form off. reviews.t: I watched a few you tube videos first to learn the technique and couldn't be happier with the results
reviews.x: Why anyone who does their own nails doesn't use these is beyond me! I watched a few you tube videos first to learn the technique and couldn't be happier with the results. Highly recommend!

reviews.x: OMG, I'm obsessed by this product. Love this product!  I have zero experience with acrylic nail yet was able to create lovely DIY acrylic nails with ASP nail forms!  The instructions and video were very helpful. Successfully created my acrylic nail on first attempt! Highly recommended product.

reviews.t: OK - but none of the forms are large enough ...
reviews.x: OK - but none of the forms are large enough for me to use on my thumb.  Had to order a different type.  Also, doesn't have any lines on it to measure your nail bed but after adding my own "line" I can use it multiple times.

reviews.t: If you want to cut back on nail salon visits try the forms
reviews.x: They work exactly as they say. I have used these forms over and over and the results are always the same. The forms pop off easy and leave a smooth glossy acrylic nail. Can be used over acrylic nail tips or create the whole nail with acrylic powder. Comes with a mini cd with instructional videos. Strong, lasting, I would recommend using a clear powder. Very simple to do and will save on salon visits. **When using these forms make sure to clean the nail bed well so the acrylic will adhere. If you

reviews.t: These work really well, the only problem is that ...
reviews.x: These work really well, the only problem is that they're very small. They only work if you have small fingers. My fingers are average sized but these are not wide enough for me so I have to put extra acrylic on the sides of my nails and try and blend it in

reviews.t: The only thing i don't like, and I'm reaching here
reviews.x: These really helped me get the hang of applying acrylics without the glue on tips. The only thing i don't like, and I'm reaching here, is the shine once you pull them off. However, I just file it a tad until I get the finish I like.

I like the forms but wish there were more in the package. If you have like sized nails and need more you just have to wait on the ones you are working on to set. I love the shine these forms give the nail when it is set. I don't know how to use them to well yet but plan on another try. The first use was not so good. I ended up with really thick nails and not the pretty, perfectly shaped ones I had hoped for.

I have been doing nails for 15 years, and always try to stay up on the new ways of doing nails... UMMM NOT!!! this product does let go of the acrylic that you add to it, but it is NOT FASTER THEN THE OLD WAY. I think even using forms is faster then using this product. I am not happy at all., good thing it was cheap cuz it ended up in the trash... YUCK!!! My opinion!!

Worked great! Very professional appearance. They've been on 5 days and still look gorgeous. Only complaint is I couldn't have a very "square" manicure, unless I made my nails real short. Since they all taper in length I shaped them into a ballerina/coffin shape. I also used a manicure drill to save a lot of work and watched a few videos on YouTube!

I am in love with this product! Works like a dream and is a great value for the price. I was able to do my own acrylics easily without them being a lumpy mess. I'll never go back to the overpriced salon again. I'll be telling every woman I know about these nail forms :)
I really enjoy these because they help me do my own at home. Because right now being out of work.
This was so misleading, it doesn't come with the filler OR a brush...

I used these forms w/Gelish Hard Gel (LED) because I couldn't get the hang of mixing acrylics properly (and didn't have time nor patience).  There are Youtube tutorials for nail forms w/gel and this helped me quite a bit.  The only downside of this kit is the thumbs weren't wide enough to fit properly from sidewall to sidewall, and it was very noticeable (never knew I had wide nail beds bec I have small hands/fingers lol).  If you have narrow nail beds, you're in luck!

reviews.t: Amazing! Makes acrylic nails super easy to do.
reviews.x: These things are wonderful. I wish I had found them sooner. They make it sooooooo much easier to do nice acrylic nails. I have reused mine several times with great results each time. My only issue is that the nail form for the thumb needs to be a little wider.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently find the forms easy to use, even for beginners and first-time acrylic users.
Many reviewers say watching YouTube or instructional videos helped them learn the technique successfully.
Several reviewers note the forms save time compared to traditional paper forms or salon visits.
Some reviewers complain the forms are not large enough for larger thumbs.
A few reviewers raise issues with pricing or receiving a damaged/incomplete package.
